decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the construction of the front boundary wall (ref 01054/735/P2(2) and indicated on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (110331/20E, 110331/21C, 110331/22E Received 24/11/2011 and Heritage Statement Rev A Received 05/05/2011 and 110331/10, 110331/11, Design & Access Statement Received 14/04/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The new brickwork shall be constructed to a professional standard using the materials shown in accordance with the approved plans. Please refer to the informative for further information on the use of lime mortar.
description: Erection of a single storey rear conservatory to the house.
